correctness.rationale: The \(10\times22\) matrix is copied from the primary full text. Its row rank and Hermitian Gram rank are both \(10\). Exact enumeration of all \(4^{10}\) words yields the stated spectrum and minimum distance \(9\). Every one of the \(\binom{22}{6}=74{,}613\) six-column sets is independent, while exactly \(88\) of the \(\binom{22}{7}=170{,}544\) seven-column sets have rank \(6\); hence the dual distance is exactly \(7\) and \(A_7=264\). The MacWilliams coefficient independently agrees. The packaged verifier replays these finite checks and returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: The primary source presents \(C'\) as a newly improved best-known Hermitian LCD code, so its exact structural fingerprint is mathematically motivated. The Hamming enumerator is the complete ordinary weight profile, while dual distance \(7\) is independent information with the concrete consequence that every six-coordinate projection is perfectly uniform. Counting the \(88\) seven-column circuits identifies the first failure of that uniformity and fixes the first nonzero dual weight coefficient. These are natural reusable invariants for comparison, equivalence testing, and subsequent construction work, not an arbitrary slice.
